description: This file defines a mock clock implementation for testing purposes within the 'ztest' package. It provides a controllable time source, including methods to get current time, create tickers, and advance time, managing waiters scheduled to trigger at specific times.

classes.name: MockClock
classes.description: A mock implementation of a clock that allows manual control over time progression for testing.

classes.name: waiter
classes.description: A helper struct representing a scheduled callback to be invoked at a specific time.

methods.name: NewMockClock
methods.description: Creates a new MockClock initialized with the current system time.

methods.name: NewTicker
methods.description: Creates a new ticker that ticks at a specified interval, only advancing when the mock clock is advanced.

methods.name: runAt
methods.description: Schedules a function to run at a specific mock time.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Advances the mock clock by a specified duration, resolving any waiters scheduled within that time frame.
